newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan investment trust body fines Nikko unit.
newsitem.headline: Japan investment trust body fines Nikko unit.

text.p: Nikko Securities Investment Trust and Management Co, an affiliate of Nikko Securities Co Ltd, has been ordered to pay 300,000 yen in fines to a Japanese investment trust industry body as a penalty for illegal bond dealings.
The Investment Trust Association said in a statement on Tuesday that it had decided to impose the fines after the Ministry of Finance handed down an administrative punishment against the company.
The Finance Ministry has banned Nikko Securities Investment Trust from establishing new trust funds for one month from June 2. The punishment was announced on May 22.

The Nikko unit has said that an in-house investigation confirmed it conducted illegal dealings in 1994 involving trading in foreign bonds at prices above their market prices. The company is five-percent owned by Nikko Securities.
The body also urged the Nikko unit to tighten its in-house system of checks to avoid any recurrence of such illegal acts.
